answer: Each agent must prove control of a unique secure-enclave key bound to a physical processor and register that key at a single public ivory registry vertex; if two identities ever present the same enclave serial, the registry slashes their entire escrowed stake. Joining an economic role requires locking collateral in a haven contract that only releases to an attested unique enclave. A sybil attacker therefore pays for a distinct hardened CPU and a full collateral deposit per fake identity, and loses the deposit upon any duplicate attestation.
